title: Saplings for the eco-club
body: A school eco-club buys three kinds of saplings for a plantation drive: neem at Rs x each, mango at Rs y each and tulsi at Rs z each. The first order of 1 neem, 1 mango and 1 tulsi sapling cost Rs 60. The second order of 2 neem, 1 mango and 3 tulsi saplings cost Rs 100. The third order of 1 neem and 2 mango saplings cost Rs 70 after a refund of the price of one tulsi sapling that had dried. These conditions give the equations x + y + z = 60, 2x + y + 3z = 100 and x + 2y - z = 70, which the club treasurer writes as AX = B, where A has rows (1, 1, 1), (2, 1, 3) and (1, 2, -1), X = (x, y, z) and B = (60, 100, 70). She plans to find |A|, check that A is non-singular, find adj A and then use X = A^(-1) B to find each price.
